besluite.fout: 'op die ... buiterande daarvan' is stiff; Afrikaans says something lies 'aan die rand' of an area.
besluite.rede: Natural fixed expression with the same location; nothing protected is touched.
It removes 'maandelikse gemiddeldes', the curriculum's own term used across the sub-topic, and 'van maand tot maand' adds 'every month through the year' rather than merely repeating it.

besluite.fout: 'die poolstreke van die ligste skakerings' reads as one noun phrase, so the reader stumbles on the attachment.
besluite.rede: 'net soos' keeps the same comparison as 'saam met' (deserts and polar regions both have the lightest shades), removes the misparse, and leaves the protected 'Op baie reënvalkaarte het hulle' intact.

besluite.fout: The generic singular 'n Plant' can be read as one plant using several methods, while the following sentences give different plants different methods.
besluite.rede: The plural matches the block's own examples and its opening 'min plante', and the protected 'op meer as een manier met min water klaar' stays word for word.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins 'Party plante hou ...' and 'ons noem hulle ...', each with its own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Required comma under AWS 2017; wording unchanged.
With an indefinite object both orders are natural Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'kom deur die warm dae' copies English 'come through'; the Afrikaans form would be the separable 'deurkom' or a plain verb.
besluite.rede: 'oorleef' is the natural, plain verb for the same meaning at Grade 6.
'in plaas van ... te vorm' is accepted standard Afrikaans; the proposal is only longer and heavier for a Grade 6 reader.
